# CyberScryb
> Free AI writers, life-document tools, and browser developer utilities

CyberScryb is a solo-built toolkit for freelancers, caregivers, and builders.
- Local browser tools (JSON, password, Base64, etc.) process data only on your device.
- AI writers (Humanizer, Gig Auto-Pilot, letters, detectors) send input to an AI backend for that one generation step; results are not stored as training data on our side.
- Free samples on AI tools; Pro unlocks unlimited full results ($5/mo or $29 lifetime).

## Flagship AI tools

- [AI Humanizer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/humanizer/): Rewrite stiff ChatGPT paste so it sounds human
- [Gig Auto-Pilot](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/gig-auto-pilot/): Job post → freelance proposal + draft
- [AI Writing Suite](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/ai-writing-suite/): Detect AI patterns and fix flagged sentences
- [Curator Prime](https://curator.cyberscryb.com): Photo → name, brand, value range, care notes
- [AI Text Summarizer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/summarizer/)
- [AI Email Writer](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/email-writer/)
- [AI Paraphraser](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/paraphraser/)
- [AI Detector](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/ai-detector/)
